descriptions.notStarted: I received permission from #p2140000#, but once I went deep inside the temple, something was stopping me and I couldn't go in further.  What did I lose this time?  I should go see #b#p2140000##k.
descriptions.inProgress: #p2140000# scratched his head and said he didn't know what happened this time.  He said unless I lost my Oblivion, which doesn't even make sense, there should be no reason I can't pass through the Road to Oblivion. \n\nHe suggested that maybe the #bGoddess' Promise#k has been broken and told me to go see  #b#p2140003##k to check the records of the promise.
descriptions.completed: I met with #p2140003#.  He said he had been waiting for me and began explaining things as if he already knew what was going on.  He said that the blessing of the Goddess of Time, can never disappear or be taken away, and it was still valid... However, he said there is another reason why I can't go deep into the temple.
